Before, the bar turned the colour of the stack's cards and kept it after the stack (WebKit hit-tests the bottom edge through clipping and through blocks with nothing sticky in them, so the last card hidden by the stack's overflow still counted). decisions.what: On phones (the ID cards as a stack, a column below 35rem) the cards do not drop: they rise 80px into place one after another, the bottom card first, 0.12s apart, 0.7s each (out), turning from −4° to their angle in the stack; the whole stack fades in as one picture (0.55s, the reveal curve). In the stack the angle goes with the place, not the card: the top card straight, then 4°, then 8° (the slot carries it, so a swap turns the cards to their new places and the stack always looks the same). The row keeps the drop and each card's own angle
decisions.decided: Tim, 2026-10-23 — in the access-cards lab: «on mobile i want cards to move from below, one after another, no drop animation», «the top card end state to be straight and the other cards on equal angles», «on swap they should also change the angle so that the stack stays the same (0, 4, 8)», «when it's a stack there's a moment when cards overlap in their transparency. i don't want that»

decisions.what: The ID cards of the row start their drop tipped 10° with the top edge toward the visitor and lie flat again at an even speed by the landing (M.DROP.tip); they fade in slowly at both ends (M.curve.reveal, cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1); 0.2s as before). A light from the top, 75° above the page, shades a face as the card tips or leans: brighter turned towards it, darker turned away, ×4 at most 45%, nothing lying flat (M.LIGHT). The shadow stays the site's own box-shadow, with a 0.5px hairline of the face's colour as its first layer, so no light line shows between the card's edge and its shadow
decisions.decided: Tim, 2026-10-23 — the settings of the access-cards lab (light from the top at 75°, shade 4, no gloss; tilt −20°, even, 1× the fall; −10° since Oct 24, Tim: «change the tilt at the start from -20 to -10»; fade 0.36 of the fall on 0.5, 0, 0.5, 1); «the drop shadow should be consistent with the current website»; «there's a thin white line at the bottom»
